capabilities: copy note links, embeds and footnote links from the file context menu
copy block links and anchors with automatic block IDs
copy block embeds and footnote links, including multi-block selections
copy block links with selected text as the caption
disambiguation: It copies Obsidian wikilinks, embeds and obsidian:// URLs for vault content, not web page URLs.
intentEvidence: This plugin builds on Copy Block Link and employs some of its code.
problem: Obsidian makes you construct block links by hand, manually adding block IDs and typing link, embed or footnote syntax for files and blocks.

relations.evidence: This plugin builds on Copy Block Link and employs some of its code.

summary: Adds context-menu commands that copy wikilinks, embeds, footnotes and obsidian:// URLs to notes and blocks, adding block IDs as needed.
